Name: Better Moss Soup
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
Did you see the moss soup recipe and immediately wonder 'Why would I make that?' No? Well... me neither, who [i]wouldn't[/i] want to eat moss!

But what I DID think was "Man I wish this was more useful..."

If you want [i]your[/i] moss soup to be more useful, this is the perfect thing for you. This mod simply adds a +1 Foraging buff to the recipe, which I think is both balanced and immensely useful, especially at the start.

Now you can feel good using that 20 moss to get a little boost when gathering berry bushes during your first spring! 


[i]Note: If you think the buff should be longer I am accepting feedback, I mostly just chose that time because it was a nice number.
[/i]

[b]If you want to be able to eat moss by itself, I recommend[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23501]Eat Moss[/url]!, which I think is both balanced and immensely useful!

[b]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [/b][b][url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things.[/b]
